save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch state dictionary to a checkpoint file in the specified directory
load_check_duplicates: load normalizer modules from a config file and warn about duplicate targets
load_from_config_fit: fit normalizer modules on a dataset using a config and save the fitted checkpoint
load_from_config_create: create normalizer modules from individual config entries and save them to a checkpoint directory
load_from_config_review: review the _load_from_config function to understand how it handles fitting versus loading from files
